proposed_widenings.name: shared_resource_activation_options
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing class_feature activation family can model one activated procedure with one shared resource, but it cannot honestly model a single feature that spends one pooled Channel Divinity use and then chooses among multiple distinct full activation procedures with different resolution families.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you use this class's Channel Divinity, choose which Channel Divinity effect from this class to create.

proposed_widenings.name: compelled_flee_from_source
proposed_widenings.justification: Turn Undead imposes an ongoing behavior that makes affected creatures spend their turns moving as far away from the cleric as possible. Existing atoms can apply Frightened and Incapacitated, but they cannot encode this source-relative compelled movement behavior honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: For that duration, it tries to move as far away from you as it can on its turns.

proposed_widenings.name: duration_end_on_source_condition_or_death
proposed_widenings.justification: The current duration early-end grammar only watches target-side events. Turn Undead also ends early when the cleric becomes Incapacitated or dies, which is a source-side lifecycle condition not representable in the existing DurationEndTrigger surface.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This effect ends early on the creature if it takes any damage, if you have the Incapacitated condition, or if you die.

notes: No content file was authored. The blocking issue is structural: Channel Divinity is a shared class-feature resource with selectable sub-effects (Divine Spark, Turn Undead, and future higher-level options), not one activation payload. Turn Undead also adds source-relative retreat behavior and source-side early-end conditions beyond the current surface.
